svg.aria-label: Left: the square [l, u] by [L, U] = [0, 1] by [0, 1] with level curves of f(x, y) = 27/20 - (x - 1/2)^2 - (y - 1/2)^2 + 3(x - 1/2)(y - 1/2), a saddle; f is 1.6 at two corners and 0.1 at the other two; its vertical edges are drawn thick blue and a dashed orange segment at height 0.7 joins them. Right: f along that segment, a concave arc above its dashed chord, from 0.76 to 1.36
